name: summarize
summary: Build a deterministic extractive operational summary, echoing structured_facts and a summary_or_translation alias for linear chain composition.
description: Third node of the report.* chain. Splits source_fragments into sentences, scores each by keyword overlap with structured_facts tokens, keeps the top 3 in original order, and renders a fixed template including the project name (defaulting to 'The project') and validated insight count. 1.1.0 additionally echoes structured_facts verbatim and emits summary_or_translation (identical to summary on this English node; report.translate-fr replaces it with the French text) so the single downstream node -- report.format directly, or report.translate-fr then report.format -- can draw every input from this one predecessor under browserLocalPlan's linear chain search (registry#441). Pure, deterministic, memory-only; summarization logic unchanged from 1.0.0.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want browser and edge evidence folded into a named project summary while the structured facts and a language-agnostic summary_or_translation field are carried alongside, so that report.format (or report.translate-fr then report.format) can consume everything from this one node.

source_fragments: Browser adoption rose. Edge cache is warm.
structured_facts: Fact: edge — Edge cache is warm
Fact: edge — Edge cache is warm
output_example.summary: Acme Rollout combines distributed browser, edge, and cloud evidence into a deterministic operational summary with 2 validated insights. Browser adoption rose. Edge cache is warm.
output_example.summary_or_translation: Acme Rollout combines distributed browser, edge, and cloud evidence into a deterministic operational summary with 2 validated insights. Browser adoption rose. Edge cache is warm.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want a single validated insight to use singular wording when no project name is supplied, so that the default template still reads correctly.

output_example.summary: The project combines distributed browser, edge, and cloud evidence into a deterministic operational summary with 1 validated insight. Cloud latency improved.
output_example.summary_or_translation: The project combines distributed browser, edge, and cloud evidence into a deterministic operational summary with 1 validated insight. Cloud latency improved.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want zero structured facts to still yield a header-only summary, so that an empty enrichment stage does not invent sentences.

output_example.summary: The project combines distributed browser, edge, and cloud evidence into a deterministic operational summary with 0 validated insights. Unrelated chatter here.
output_example.summary_or_translation: The project combines distributed browser, edge, and cloud evidence into a deterministic operational summary with 0 validated insights. Unrelated chatter here.

preconditions.description: Caller supplies source_fragments and structured_facts arrays (either may be empty).

postconditions.description: Identical input always yields an identical summary string. Sentence scoring and top-k selection use no randomness, clocks, or host state.

side_effects.description: Produces one summary string in memory; does not log, persist, or transmit inputs.
